prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web app comp, landscape approximately 1440×1000
Primary request: Redesign the logged-in home page of “서울 촌놈”, a private travel-memory archive used repeatedly by one couple. Direction name: 기억의 연대기. The first viewport opens with one recent past journey as the emotional focal point, then immediately begins a dense newest-first chronological archive so old trips are quick to retrieve. Travel and day-out records are not merged; travel is the main body, day-outs are a clearly separate secondary destination.
Input image: existing Seoul Chonnom screen, reference for warm-paper palette, restrained Seoul Pink accent, Korean workhorse sans typography and quiet product character only. Do not carry over its floating pill desktop header, narrow mobile-like central column, placeholder illustration content, or current layout.
Structure: compact flat desktop header with supplied SLCN mark area and only Home, 여행, 나들이, 달력 as primary destinations; shoes and Film Art are absent from primary navigation and live under a quiet secondary more/profile destination. Below, a concise title “지난 여행” with small “만난 지 653일째”. A large but not full-screen recent-memory composition uses one decisive travel photograph with date, place, title “속초 2박 3일”, and one-line review “바다와 시장 사이를 오래 걸었던 여름 여행.” beside or directly beneath it. The photo occupies roughly half the first viewport, never a rounded card. A thin year jump index and understated search control sit at the transition into a dense newest-first travel list. Show the beginning of rows for “부산, 비 오는 주말”, “제주 겨울”, and “강릉의 늦여름” with dates, region, duration and small varied thumbnails. Use an editorial asymmetric grid with meaningful empty space, but use the desktop width fully.
Style: calm, precise, mature production interface refined over years; warm paper #FFF8F8, ink #1B1B1B, white, Seoul Pink #FE9FC8 used sparingly, muted rose gray. Pretendard-like Korean sans throughout. Flat content surfaces, hairline rules, varied information density, clear hierarchy. No glass on desktop.
Constraints: preserve readable Korean UI, actual app surface not a landing page, semantic-looking controls, photography is the content. No 3-column feature cards, no card grid, no nested cards, no excessive pills, no icon tile plus heading plus description, no purple or blue gradient, no large gradient hero, no uniform section spacing, no decorative shadow, no glow, no glass desktop shell, no marketing copy, no metrics dashboard.
